title: Martialytics vs Gymdesk: Pricing & Features (2026)
description: Martialytics vs Gymdesk compared on published student-based prices, payment processing, trials, belt tracking and what each includes.
body:
Martialytics and Gymdesk both price by active students, include every feature on every tier and offer a 30-day trial with no credit card. The real differences are the price at your headcount, how you take payments, and what's bundled.

{{table:martialytics,gymdesk}}

Price at your headcount (published, USD/month)

Active studentsMartialyticsGymdesk (with Gymdesk Payments)Gymdesk (own processor)
Up to 50$69$75$100
51-100$99$100$125
101-150$129$150$175
151-200$129$200$240
201-250$199$200$240
251+$199Enterprise (quoted)Enterprise (quoted)

Sources: martialytics.com/pricing and gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-10-22.

Payments

Martialytics says it uses standard Stripe rates with no markup and no revenue percentage. Gymdesk is $25/mo cheaper on every tier if you use Gymdesk Payments (US and Canada) or an approved partner, but Gymdesk doesn't publish that processing rate.

What's bundled

Gymdesk includes a responsive gym website and unlimited staff accounts on every plan; door access ($100/mo for up to 3 doors) and a branded member app ($100/mo) are add-ons. Martialytics includes unlimited users, unlimited locations, unlimited emails and a free student app. Gymdesk charges $50/mo per extra location (with Gymdesk Payments) or $100/mo (own processor).

Which to pick

If you have multiple locations or 151-200 students, Martialytics' published price is lower. If you want a website included and are happy with Gymdesk Payments, Gymdesk is within a few dollars at 51-100 students. Both offer a 30-day trial with no card, so you can try both. {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}} {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}

Do Martialytics and Gymdesk have free trials?
Both offer a 30-day free trial with no credit card required, per their pricing pages.
Yes. Gymdesk says every plan includes a responsive gym website and unlimited staff accounts.
Gymdesk charges $50/mo per additional location with Gymdesk Payments or a preferred partner, or $100/mo with your own processor. Martialytics lists unlimited locations on every plan.
Do they lock you into a contract?
Neither does. Gymdesk is month to month with no setup or cancellation fee, and Martialytics says there are no lock-in contracts.
